facts.text: The Go Blue Guarantee covers full undergraduate tuition and mandatory university fees for full-time, in-state students with an incoming 3.5 GPA and family income and assets of $125,000 or less.

sources.title: Go Blue Guarantee – Office of Financial Aid
sources.quote: The Go Blue Guarantee is a free-tuition initiative covering qualified students' full undergraduate tuition and mandatory university fees.

sources.title: Go Blue Guarantee – Office of Financial Aid
sources.quote: Incoming students (first-year) must have a 3.5 GPA. Transfer students must have a 3.5 GPA.

sources.title: Go Blue Guarantee – Office of Financial Aid
sources.quote: Have family incomes of $125,000 or less and assets below $125,000.
